@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Hypothesis.** The second-quarter dip looks the same for every
    carrier type. Outcome: each carrier type's Q2 shipments fell from
    2023 to 2024 by a percentage within 5 points of the overall fall of
    28%.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def dip_by_carrier_type(pl, shipments):
    _year = pl.col('ship_date').dt.year()
    _q2 = (
        shipments.filter(pl.col('ship_date').dt.quarter().eq(2))
        .group_by('carrier_type')
        .agg(
            q2_2023=_year.eq(2023).sum().cast(pl.Int64),
            q2_2024=_year.eq(2024).sum().cast(pl.Int64),
        )
        .with_columns(drop=pl.col('q2_2023').sub(pl.col('q2_2024')))
        .with_columns(
            pct_change=pl.col('q2_2024').truediv(pl.col('q2_2023')).sub(1),
            share_of_drop=pl.col('drop').truediv(pl.col('drop').sum()),
        )
        .sort('drop', descending=True)
        .collect()
    )
    _q2
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Facts.** Across all carrier types, Q2 shipments fell 28%, from 159
    to 115. Container fell from 92 to 66, a drop of 26 (−28%, 59% of the
    drop). Tanker fell from 23 to 13, a drop of 10 (−43%, 23% of the
    drop). Bulk fell from 44 to 36, a drop of 8 (−18%, 18% of the drop).
    The falls range from 18% to 43%.
    """)
    return
